title: Minimal Poisoning Budget for Emergent Misalignment: How Little Malicious Data Is Needed?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly relevant to data curation safety: knowing the minimum poisoning threshold informs how carefully training data must be vetted. Clear chain from finding to actionable risk assessment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses open emergent-misalignment codebase. Varying data ratios is conceptually simple. However, running multiple fine-tuning runs at different ratios requires significant GPU time and careful experimental tracking. Medium compute suffices for small models.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined single variable (poisoning ratio) with clear deliverable (threshold curve). Can be scoped to one model and 5 ratio levels. Clean experimental design fits 30 hours if using a 7B model.
